findings.title: Documented "required" status of PAYMENT_PROVIDER_KEY is not enforced
findings.explanation: The table marks `PAYMENT_PROVIDER_KEY` as required. The code in `src/lib/provider.ts` (lines 23 and 42) interpolates `process.env.PAYMENT_PROVIDER_KEY` directly, and nothing validates it at startup. If the variable is missing, the API sends `Authorization: Bearer undefined` to the provider and fails at request time. The same applies to `DATABASE_URL`, where `pg` silently falls back to its own defaults. The docs are accurate about intent, but I suggest adding a fail-fast check at startup and noting in the README that the service will not start without these variables. This can be a follow-up and does not block the PR.
